usedFor: Slack holds your members, and Dialpad receives each as a contact through “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New User Joined or Updated in Your Org” in Slack, then “Create Contact” in Dialpad
bestTemplate.why: New teammates are added to Dialpad as contacts, so people can find and call them.

watchOut: “New User Joined or Updated in Your Org” is polling and fires on updates, so a person can repeat.
